body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> As the consumer demand for portability and convenience continues to grow, Toshiba has enhanced its premium line-up of portable DVD players to include new larger screen sizes, sleek cosmetic designs, extended battery life and convenient swivel screens.

Toshiba’s top of the line ‘SD-P101S’ features a large 10.2-inch widescreen LCD swivel screen and a high resolution display of 800 x 400 pixels, offering premium picture quality to consumers on the move.

Allowing plenty of time to enjoy movies, the SD-P101S offers approximately five hours of battery life. With a 4-in-1 (SD, MMC, MS and xD) Memory Card slot, the SD-P101S is a convenient travel partner to view digital photos.

This model features Digital Cinema Progressive scan output and is DivX® Home Theater Certified. Plus, the SD-P101S comes complete with a car cord adapter, making it the perfect mobile companion. It is available for 299.99(USD) in April 2008.
